title.label: Item name
title.hint: Shown on hover and as the plaque header. May be empty.

text.label: Inspection text
text.hint: What the character sees. With a skill check — the success text.

checkMode.label: Check
checkMode.hint: Roll — the player rolls the skill on first inspection; passive — the passive skill score is compared, no roll.

range.label: Range
range.hint: In scene units from the token to the zone edge. 0 — unlimited.

gmNote.label: GM note
gmNote.hint: Hidden from players. Whispered to the GM when someone inspects the zone.

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: Plays for whoever sees the plaque.

duration.label: Display time, s
duration.hint: 0 — the plaque stays until closed or clicked away.

Repeat.once: Once, then the zone goes dark

BURNINSPECT.TooFar: You can't make it out from here — move closer.
BURNINSPECT.NoGM: No GM in the game: the inspection won't be remembered.

GmReport.Name: Inspect: GM report in chat
GmReport.Hint: When a player inspects a zone, the GM gets a whisper with who, what and the result, plus the GM note.

BURNINSPECT.ToRegionsHint: Add inspection to regions selected on the Regions layer
BURNINSPECT.ManagerHint: You can also draw a zone yourself: Regions layer → any shape → behavior "🔥 Inspect Item".
BURNINSPECT.NoZones: No inspection zones on this scene yet.
BURNINSPECT.SeenHint: How many characters have inspected it
BURNINSPECT.ResetAllConfirm: Forget who has inspected what on this scene? Checks will be rolled again.
BURNINSPECT.DeleteRegionConfirm: Delete region "{name}" together with the inspection?
BURNINSPECT.DeleteBehaviorConfirm: Remove the inspection from the region? Other behaviors stay.
BURNINSPECT.PickTile: Click the item's tile (Esc to cancel)
BURNINSPECT.PickPoint: Click where to place the zone (Esc to cancel)
